Typography — Plus Jakarta Sans only
10px / 700 / ls 1.5px / uppercasesection-label, eyebrowMATCHED FOR YOU
11px / 700 / ls 1.2px / uppercaseform field labelFIRST NAME
12px / 500meta, counts, sub infoSeries B · Remote
13–14px / 400–500body, descriptionsYour community and opportunities — matched to your profile.
14px / 600 / ls -.15pxcard titles, row titlesHead of Product
16px / 700button text, sub-headsRequest access
22px / 600 / ls -.5pxpage titleAcademy
26px / 700 / ls -.6pxsection headingProduct
Spacing: base 4px. Common values: 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 20, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48px
Border radius: sm=8px md=12px lg=18px xl=22px full=999px
Card shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(16,12,46,.04), 0 8px 28px rgba(16,12,46,.07)
Modal shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(13,15,43,.08), 0 32px 80px rgba(13,15,43,.18)
Card border: 1px solid rgba(16,12,46,.1)
Divider: 1px solid rgba(16,12,46,.07)
App max-width: 1220px · Landing max-width: 1380px

Mobile breakpoints:
<768px — nav tabs collapse to icons only, search hidden, avatar name hidden
<900px — inner-card grid stacks (sidebar on top, content below), feature grid 2-col
<480px — feature grid 1-col, full-width cards, input font-size min 16px (prevents iOS zoom)
Touch targets: min 44px height on all interactive elements

All app screens share: font (Plus Jakarta Sans) · background (#EEEBE4) · max-width (1220px) · nav pattern · mobile breakpoints
Connected block pattern (sidebar + content, one white card) used in: Academy, Network
Page = white card on cream bg — not floating glass. Cards are solid white with a single border and shadow.
Pink is interaction-only (required fields, error states) · Lavender for links, labels, active states · Teal for brand accents · Green for success/founder track
